newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gold's weaker cycle may be ending - Dresdner Bank.
newsitem.headline: Gold's weaker cycle may be ending - Dresdner Bank.

text.p: Physical gold demand in some regions and the build-up of new short positions may point to an end of the weak gold price cycle, Dresdner Bank said in a weekly precious metals report.
It did not rule out a short-term downside test of the 18-month low at $379, but saw potential buying at that level.
But if gold found a floor above $383, a quick upside move could follow.
The bank ruled out substantial price changes to either side in the short term, concluding that low volatility would curtail near-term options transactions.
London gold closed firmer on Friday at $380.90/381.40.
